content.value: The R.J Smith corporation is a publisher of novels. The corporation hires an economist to (20) determine the demand for its product. After months of hard work, the economist informs the company that the demand for the firm's novel is given by the following equation:
$Q _ { x }$ is the demand for $\mathbb { R } _ { : } \mathbb { J }$ smith novels.
$P _ { x }$ is the price charged for R.J smith novel.
I is the income per capita.
$P _ { c }$ is the price of novels from competing publishers.
Assume that the initial values of $P _ { x } , \mathrm { I }$ and $P _ { c }$ are \$5, \$10000 and \$6 respectively.
Using the above information, the company's manager wants to-
(i) Determine what effect a price increase would have on total revenue.
(ii) Evaluate how rates of the novel would change during a period of rising income.
(iii) Assess the problem impact if competing publishers would raise their price
